Delhi High Court on Answer Key Challenges and Re-evaluation

The Delhi High Court has ruled that challenges to the correctness of model answer keys are maintainable and distinct from seeking a re-evaluation of an answer sheet. This decision clarifies the scope of judicial review concerning examination processes. The court's stance provides a pathway for candidates to contest alleged errors in answer keys before resorting to re-evaluation requests.
